_comment: Mid360 network configuration for the G1 (§12, Phase 5A).
IPs verified on-robot 2026-08-07 (checklist 5B-1): host_net_info is the
Jetson's eth0 address (192.168.123.164); lidar_configs.ip is the Mid360
itself at 192.168.123.120 (Unitree factory setting on the 123 subnet,
MAC 8c:58:23:89:39:7a — the stock Livox 192.168.1.1XX serial convention
does NOT apply, Unitree reflashes it). test/hw_config_check.py refuses
to pass until host_net_info IPs are actually assigned to a local
interface, so a wrong value fails on the bench instead of silently
extrinsic_parameter stays identity by decree (§8.3): the driver emits
points in the sensor frame and TF (g1_description) does the rest. Do not
put H-1 here as well or the extrinsic is applied twice.
There is NO timestamp-mode field: sync mode is a LiDAR-side setting the
driver reads out of each packet header. With no PTP/GPS source the driver
falls back to host clock at packet-reception time (pub_handler.cpp
GetEthPacketTimestamp). §14.3's 'host-time mode' is that fallback, not a
configuration. Which mode is live is a 5B measurement (checklist 5B-1).
